# pip-audit: accepted advisories for requirements.txt / requirements-ingest.txt.
# Read by .github/workflows/pip-audit.yml: one advisory id per line (PYSEC-, GHSA- or
# CVE- ids all match, since pip-audit compares aliases), text after '#' is a comment.
# The job fails on any advisory NOT listed here, so a new advisory or a newly added
# vulnerable pin shows up. Baseline taken 2026-10-11 with pip-audit 2.9.0 (#538).
# Add a line only with a reason; delete lines when the package is upgraded.
